main_body: A low wooden counter base (rows 22-29) topped with a glass dome (rows 10-22) that holds a tiered cake. The dome is the largest volume and is drawn as a front-view semicircle.
top_band: none. The column at x=16 goes from the dome outline (blue, row 10) through pale glass and cake rows to the counter edge at row 22 (orange, L=157). Rows 24-29 are the wooden front. No horizontal top surface of the counter or dome reads as a band.
evidence: The glass dome is a flat front-view semicircle with the cake drawn face-on as stacked tiers. It shows no top surface seen from above. The wooden base is a flat front panel with a 1-row edge (row 22) and a dark row 23 under it, which is a thin rim and not a surface. The inset drawer panels in the base are drawn recessed, but they are vertical faces. The object also reads as a counter-top dome, not tall furniture against a wall, so kind_matches is false. Overall it is a front elevation with only a rim at the top of the base.

style.evidence: Measured facts: 14 colours per tile against 17 and 20 for the references, 9% flat-fill coverage (under the stall's 13%), 0% neutral dark edge pixels, and 19 distinct colours against 38-40. The outline is tinted brown on the wood and blue on the glass. Shading has about 5 steps (glass blue, pale cream, cream and orange tiers, brown wood), with a layered cake and glass highlights. The palette is much smaller than both references and the wood front is mostly plain with few grain dots. It is thinner than the references overall, but tile density is close to them. Pass is borderline, but the tinted outlines, moderate density and non-flat fills hold up next to the references.
